locations.note: The story opens with a museum heist in Istanbul for a clue to Marco Polo's lost fleet.
A jungle dig site in Borneo for Marco Polo's lost fleet draws Drake into Lazarević's hunt.
A war-torn Nepalese city hides the temple clues pointing toward Shambhala.
A Tibetan village in the Himalayas is the last stop before the search for Shambhala.

routes.name: Nathan Drake
routes.note: From a museum heist in Istanbul to Marco Polo's lost fleet in Borneo, through war-torn Nepal and up into the Himalayas in search of Shambhala.
